clauses.text: Measure waiting time from recorded driver_arrival_time to cancellation_time, including early arrival. This is a sample assumption.
The free wait period is five minutes. Its expiry alone does not establish the eight-minute no-show condition.
The no-show time condition is met when the recorded driver wait is at least eight minutes. This time check alone is not a final ruling.
The sample no-show charge is SGD 5.00, designated as driver compensation. A full reversal recommends returning the charged amount to the rider; no real payment is executed.

GPS is evidence of the recorded driver location. It does not establish the rider location or resolve ambiguity about the physical pickup entrance. Contact records are relevant context; this sample sets no separate mandatory contact count.
Do not decide fee validity from ratings, dispute history, or fraud flags. Refer unresolved material contradictions or missing facts for human review.
